dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge forming a high-degree falcate spline from the posterior base to the sub-apex region.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Blunted, irregular apex showing truncated geometry; non-acute, low-radius rounded edges at the terminal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 35-40 degree ascending slope relative to the horizontal dorsal midline, showing slight convex curvature as it approaches the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.5:1 ratio of longitudinal base width to vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant truncation/amputation of the dorsal fin apex; small notch present at the lower posterior insertion point of the trailing edge; subtle depigmented scarring visible on the lower lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The distinctive blunt-top morphology of the dorsal fin serves as a primary identifying characteristic.
